title: Sand
body:
Description

Sand ore can uniquely spawn in Sandstone nodes. Sand ore can spawn on the beaches of Finlay Island.

The raw form of Sand takes on a yellow color similar to Sandstone.

Putting sand into a refiner will raise the sell price to $22 per stud. Putting that refined Sand through a forge will further raise the sell price to $24 per stud and create clear glass.

Like any other materials in the game, you can use sand and glass to complete schematics.

Trivia

  • Sand is the only ore to spawn in Sandstone nodes.
